objective: Publish a curated, self-contained Rev5 WIP viewer and cleared software on the existing public repository and Pages site.
authority: The project owner explicitly requested public repository reflection and normal merge to main followed by Pages verification, conditional on required CI and publication checks.

viewer.rights: Candidate only: trace first-party code and geometry provenance before export.

software_candidates.name: C1 readiness
software_candidates.boundary: Not an orderable BOM; zero adopted candidates.

software_candidates.name: Synthetic IMU disagreement
software_candidates.boundary: Offline synthetic gyro reporting only; no health decisions or control.

software_candidates.name: N8R8 evaluation
software_candidates.boundary: NOT_FOR_FLASH; measurement subset, not the full Rev5 configuration.

conditions: Export only cleared immutable files; no private ancestry or whole-branch merge.
No license, permission, branch-protection or engineering-gate changes.
No manufacturer originals, raw uploads, private receipts, SDK snapshots or host-specific data.
Other software requires its independent review and a portable public input closure.
Source-linked limits remain WIP / NOT ASSEMBLY READY, UNKNOWN, NOT_FOR_FLASH and original 44 = 2 closed / 42 unfinished.
Normal merge requires passing required checks and publication audit; verify deployment and actual live rendering afterward.
stop_when: A specific required rights, source, authorization, check or approval prerequisite is missing, or the finite cleared release has been deployed and verified.
provenance_note: Sanitized publication commission derived from the owner's instructions; not a replacement for original private records.
